name: Review Pull Requests
description: List and review pull requests in a repository. Fetches PRs with full details including diff stats, reviews, and review comments. Handles the multi-step orchestration: list PRs, fetch details, fetch reviews.

state.description: Filter by state: open, closed, or all

sort.description: Sort by: created, updated, or popularity

includeReviews.description: Fetch review status for each PR

steps.name: List pull requests from the repository
Check if any PRs were found
Fetch full details and reviews for each PR
Get full PR details (includes diff stats)
